title: fix(mcp,storage): say which upload link a lock refuses; close the upload-link relay's code
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #32783

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`create_upload_link` 的工具说明和 connect-mcp 文档页，现在说清楚"锁定记录、只读字段不发链接"只针对字段目标；附件链接只问附件本身的两个问题，所以审批锁定中的记录照样能拿到附件链接并成功附上。另外，上传链接页面和上传接口转发拒绝时，`error.code` 改为平台闭合错误码，应用自定义的未注册码放到旁边的 `declaredCode`，与同文件提交接口的做法一致。
- 为什么改：代理按工具说明决定要不要给用户发链接；旧说法会让它以为审批中的记录不能加附件，从而错误地拒绝用户。
- 风险与回滚：patch 级。说明文字只改措辞，不改判定规则；错误码归一只影响抛出未注册码的应用钩子（平台自己抛的码都已注册，答复不变）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts` 的 `relayUploadLinkRefusal`；`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `create_upload_link` 描述；`content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` 的 `create_upload_link` 条目。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/storage-routes.upload-link-refusal-relay.test.ts`，预期 7 个全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**S1, the description says which link each refusal applies to.** Measured at `origin/main` `67188849` (`RecordFileAccess.createUploadLinkAs`, `record-file-access.ts`):

| Description sentence | Branch that serves it |
|---|---|
| The user must be able to edit the record | Both targets: a field link asks `mayEditAttachmentParent` (`PERMISSION_DENIED` 403); an attachments link asks `assertMayAttach`, the `sys_attachment` create permission plus the same parent-edit verdict (`ATTACHMENT_PARENT_ACCESS` 403). |
| A field link needs a field they may write | Field branch only: `getWritableFields` (`FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE` 403). |
| A `readonly` field gets no link | Field branch only: `fieldDef.readonly === true` (403). |
| A field whose `readonlyWhen` holds now gets no link | Field branch only, since #32768: `engine.judgeFieldWriteLock` (403, naming the lock). |
| A record a pending approval locks gets no link | Field branch only: `approvals.getRecordLock` (`RECORD_LOCKED` 409). |
| A locked record still takes attachments (new) | The attachments branch asks no lock, and attaching writes a `sys_attachment` row and the `sys_file` row, never the parent, so the approvals lock (a `beforeUpdate` on the parent) never runs. Measured, see Verification. |
| An upload refused when it arrives | Field link: the strict write (`strictReadonlyWrites`) refuses a field that became read-only, and the lock hook refuses a record locked after minting (`RECORD_LOCKED` 409, pinned in `record-file-access.integration.test.ts`). |
| The new-record limb (#32686) | Unchanged: `createUploadLinkForNewRecordAs` asks create permission, the writable field and `readonly`; `readonlyWhen` is judged by the create. |

The description and `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` now say the lock and the read-only refusals belong to a field link, and that an attachments link to a locked record is issued and attaches. "for this record and field only" now reads "for this record and this field (or its attachments) only". The served skill text (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` and its console mirror) does not restate the lock or the read-only refusals, so it is not changed.

**N2, the relay's code is closed.** `relayUploadLinkRefusal` (`storage-routes.ts`) answered the thrown spelling under an `as ErrorCode` cast. It now answers `resolveThrownHttpError(err).code`, with `demotedDeclaredCode(thrown)` beside it as `declaredCode`, as `relayAttachFailure` in the same file does. The ruling read: the module note of `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`, "[#9106] That limb was ruled (maintainer, 2026-08-16): `error.code` is a closed vocabulary at every door". The 503 arm still relays only a code spelled `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`: it reads the spelling (`thrown.declaredCode`), because an unregistered spelling at 503 derives `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and reading the closed code would widen the arm.

**N3, the docblock names all three `declaredStatus` limbs**: `status`, then `statusCode`, then the validation shape, which declares 400. It also says a throw with no string `code` is not relayed.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.upload-link-refusal-relay.test.ts` (new) mounts the storage family over a link door that throws a chosen refusal and drives the page `GET` and the upload `PUT`:

- an unregistered 4xx spelling answers the code its status derives (a registered one) with the spelling as `declaredCode`, on both doors (ablated);
- a 503 spelled with an unregistered code stays the route's 500, and a 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` relays (ablated);
- a registered spelling answers verbatim with no `declaredCode` (control);
- `statusCode` 409 `RECORD_LOCKED` answers 409;
- the validation shape, with no `status` or `statusCode`, answers 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` (N3);
- a throw declaring no status is the route's 500 (control).

## Acceptance notes

- **Who sees a different `code`.** Every code the storage service's own link verbs throw is registered (`ATTACHMENT_DOWNLOAD_DENIED`, `FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, `FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED`, `FILE_NOT_FOUND`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `RECORD_LOCKED`, `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, each checked with `ErrorCode.safeParse`), so their answers are unchanged. A refusal whose spelling is not registered, such as an application hook's own code on the upload's write, now answers the derived code in `error.code` and its own spelling in `error.declaredCode`. The page's sentence does not change: every code it has its own sentence for is registered.
- **A stale module note, outside this file surface.** The `record-file-access.ts` module docblock still says a `readonlyWhen` lock "has no judgement a door can ask without writing, so it is judged when the link is used". Since #32768 minting asks `judgeFieldWriteLock`. Comment drift only; noted, not filed.
- **The validation shape keeps no `fields` here.** The relay answers `VALIDATION_FAILED` 400 without `details.fields`, as before; `relayAttachFailure` passes them. Not asked by the card; noted.
- N1 (the page's wording) is carried by #32712.
- `mcp-http-tools.ts` is shared with #32872 (PR #33134), #31699 and #32442; this diff touches only the `create_upload_link` description.

## Verification

On head `9292068c` (one merge of `origin/main` `f054a0b3`, no conflict) unless stated.

<details><summary>Measurement at origin/main 67188849: a locked record, two targets</summary>

A throwaway case (not committed) in `record-file-access.integration.test.ts`, the record locked through the fixture's lock answer and its `beforeUpdate` lock hook:

```text
MEASURE attach on locked => {"landed":{"fileId":"84b4ed19-…","size":13,"attachmentId":"zkWBtwqYRFhhINTb"},"parent":true}
MEASURE field on locked => {"code":"RECORD_LOCKED","status":409,"message":"You cannot attach a file to claim/… now: it is locked while an approval is in progress."}
Tests  1 passed | 51 skipped (52)
```

The attachments link was issued and its upload landed a `sys_attachment` on the locked record; the field link was refused 409. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (src, read directly by the suite)</summary>

Both ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proved the mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed) and restored the blob (`e1f86c0c…` before and after). `git diff HEAD` was empty after each.

- N2: `sendError(res, status, thrown.code, …, declaredCode)` put back to `sendError(res, status, e.code as ErrorCode, message, { userMessage })`. Red, 2 failed / 5 passed: `GET` and `PUT` "a 4xx refusal spelling an unregistered code answers a registered one", `expected 'CLAIM_DESK_SAYS_NO' to be 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`.
- The 503 arm: `thrown.declaredCode === 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'` replaced with `thrown.code === 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'`. Red, 1 failed / 6 passed: "a 503 relays only as spelled SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", `expected 503 to be 500`.

</details>

<details><summary>Tests, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test`: Test Files 83 passed (83), Tests 1554 passed (1554).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: Test Files 63 passed (63), Tests 1104 passed (1104).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- The new suite alone: Tests 7 passed (7).

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 102 of 102, exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 102 commands from 5 paths; each ran with stdin from `/dev/null` and its exit code was written to disk. Three first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:skill-examples` needs the client SDK built, `check:i18n` the CLI closure, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` a full build). Each exited 0 after the build it names. `--ran` with every exit recorded: "102 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 102 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 102 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". `check-nul-bytes`: exit 0.

</details>

Dogfood: n/a, since the title has no `!` and Clause-② has no `(narrowing)` arm.
